settings.title: Company Information
settings.body:
Line Commercial is a company dedicated to e-commerce through the sale of products over the internet.

For any inquiries related to our services, orders, or policies, you may contact us at:

settings.title: Purpose of the Website
settings.body:
This website is intended to provide information about our products and allow their purchase through a secure e-commerce platform.

All published information is for informational and commercial purposes.

settings.body: By using this website, the user agrees to: (1) Provide truthful and up-to-date information during the purchase process. (2) Use the website only for lawful purposes. (3) Not engage in activities that may affect the security, operation, or availability of the website. (4) Not use the site's content for fraudulent or illegal activities. Line Commercial reserves the right to suspend or restrict access to any user who fails to comply with these conditions.

We constantly work to keep product information up to date. However, availability, features, prices, and specifications may change without prior notice.

Product images are for illustrative purposes and may present slight differences from the product received due to manufacturing processes, lighting, or screen settings.

We will not be liable for delays arising from transport companies, customs processes, natural phenomena, unforeseen circumstances, or any situation beyond our reasonable control.

settings.title: Contact Information
settings.body: If you have any questions regarding this Legal Notice or the operation of our website, please contact our customer service team, and we will be happy to assist you.
